_comment: 5 ready-to-run A/B test presets. Set the corresponding `enabled` to true ONE AT A TIME (running 5 simultaneous tests on a low-traffic site dilutes statistical power). Run for 1-2 weeks per test, pick the winner, mark `enabled=false` and bake the winner into the source.
_runtime_note: blog-shared.js auto-loads this file when BL.AB_AUTOLOAD === '/build/ab-tests.json'. See SETUP.md.

variants.A: 用 BrillianceLab 計算器先算分

cta_text._hypothesis: Variant B emphasises speed (the deciding-factor for impatient mobile readers); C removes friction. Expected winner: B.

variants.A: 2026 鑽石市場降幅,你可能想知道
variants.B: 下個月鑽石可能再降 8%,要追蹤嗎?
variants.C: 別錯過下次降價的內幕信

exit_popup_headline._hypothesis: Specificity (B) outperforms vagueness (A); fear-of-missing-out (C) outperforms both — IF readers trust the implied data.

sticky_cta_text._hypothesis: B (value-framing) and C (process-framing) test different mental models. Round-1 hypothesis: B wins on mobile (curiosity), C wins on desktop (engineering audience).

variants.B: 下個月買鑽,該等還是該下手?
variants.C: 鑽石內行月報 — 不寄垃圾

newsletter_headline._hypothesis: B is question-headline (high CTR), C is reassurance + identity. Both should beat A.

hub_card_color._hypothesis: Visually-distinguished related-cards (B/C) get more clicks than monochrome (A). Test shows whether the visual cost (slightly busier UI) is worth the CTR gain.

_how_to_read_results.where: GA4 → Reports → Engagement → Events → experiment_impression / experiment_conversion
_how_to_read_results.metric: Conversion rate per variant = (experiment_conversion count for variant X) ÷ (experiment_impression count for variant X)
_how_to_read_results.decision_rule: Winner = highest conversion rate AFTER ≥ 200 impressions per variant. If under 200/variant after 14 days, your traffic isn't enough — stop the test, ship the variant that LOOKS best on intuition.
